set.request: Build the two Page.css rules (fill yields to open child; column head pad-y with square x inset), restore width fill on both research fronts, measure widths, document in columns.md and decisions.md
steps: add head pad-y + square inset rule
restore width fill on two research fronts
measure cloudflare verdict path widths at 3440
set.outcome: **Two rules landed in `core/Page/Page.css`.** `fill` yields to an open child (`.page.active-ancestor > .page-column-body.page-column-fill { --page-column-flex: 1 1 0; --page-column-max: 64em; }`) and both research fronts are `width: "fill"` again. The column head breathes on `--page-column-pad-y` (`padding-block`) with `padding-inline: var(--page-column-pad-x) var(--page-column-pad-y)`, so the `×` sits in a square `pad-y` inset instead of `pad-x`. Measured headless @3440: `/imagine/research/` alone fills the row (3008px); with `stone/barabar-caves/` open, rail 432 / front 1090 / topic 828 / leaf 1090; the cloudflare verdict path (`/imagine/platform/research/cloudflare/verdict/`) reads rail 432 / hub 752 / front 752 / topic 752 / verdict 752 — every column over 600px. Head @1280/2474/3440: height 73/71/87px, × inset top 25/21/29px vs right 11/20/28px (converging, was 11 vs 41 at 2474 before). Zero console errors on the two touched fronts (one pre-existing, unrelated routing-probe 404 on the verdict leaf's own page.js probe, by design — it falls back to verdict.md). Documented in `doc/columns.md` (2 notes) and `doc/decisions.md` (dated entry with both tables).
